# Freelance Content Delivery

## Purpose
Prepare original, brief-aligned content that a freelancer can review and deliver to a client. This workflow creates drafts and supporting metadata only.

## Intake
Capture topic, audience, goal, tone, primary/secondary keywords, target length, CTA, brand voice, format, references, jurisdiction, and prohibited claims. Confirm whether factual sources were supplied and whether expert review is required.

## Workflow
1. Build a short content brief and outline.
2. Research factual claims using public primary sources where possible. Record source URLs and dates.
3. Draft the requested article, product description, newsletter draft, social copy, or short video script.
4. Add optional SEO title, meta description, slug, and suggested internal links.
5. Check clarity, originality, grammar, factual support, audience fit, and CTA consistency.
6. Deliver the draft with summary, source list, assumptions, and unresolved questions.

## SEO and editorial principles
- Write naturally for the reader and search intent.
- Use keywords where relevant; do not target arbitrary keyword-density percentages or stuff keywords.
- Follow requested length and format without padding.
- Use descriptive headings and logical hierarchy.
- Cite factual statements and verify statistics. If a claim cannot be verified, remove it or label it unverified.
- Do not fabricate testimonials, credentials, case studies, product capabilities, discounts, guarantees, or performance outcomes.
- Do not imitate a living writer's distinctive style. Match general tone attributes from the client brief.
- Respect platform character limits and content rules, checking current requirements when they matter.

## Deliverable package
- content-draft.md — full draft
- content-brief.md — audience, goal, format, keywords, and constraints
- sources.md — URLs, dates, and claims supported
- qa-checklist.md — originality, factuality, structure, and remaining review items

## Safety boundaries
- Drafts only. Never publish, schedule, post, send newsletters, message followers, or connect accounts.
- Do not collect subscriber lists, personal data, or private customer information.
- Do not add tracking pixels or affiliate links unless supplied and approved by the user; flag where disclosures may be required.
- Do not use paid writing, SEO, stock-image, or distribution services. No paid spend or external write operations.
- Do not guarantee rankings, engagement, leads, conversions, or revenue.
- User approval and app-level permission checks are required before any external side effect.

## Provenance and limitations
Adapted from the MIT-licensed CashClaw content-writer skill. CashClaw CLI commands, npm installation requirements, unsupported engagement statistics, arbitrary keyword-density targets, and publishing/sending implications were removed. No CashClaw runtime or package dependency is imported.
